messages.subject: Re: Warning: Using formula(x) is deprecated when x is a character vector of length > 1. Consider formula(paste(x, collapse = " ")) instead.
parts: This is due to a bug (fixed in the dev version of the package) that appears when the formula is very long. You can ignore it for models, like yours, that don't include random effects.
